assertion_analysis.failure_condition: after == before[path] fails if any retired-day minute or hour line is dropped, reordered, or rewritten; before is read from disk before rebuild and after from disk after, so the two sides are independent, and repair-final-declared-negative.log shows the declared interval mutation reddens present_days1.
fault in caplog.text fails if a manifest-Write OSError, a tier os.replace OSError, or a scheduler RuntimeError is raised out of the pass without being logged, or stops the loop before two ticks.
len(attempts) == 2 fails if a locked vacuum is not retried on the next pass or is retried twice; repair-negative-cleanup-retry.log shows the pre-fix code reddens the sibling assertion.
forgotten == [(raw,), (raw,)] fails if a failed index.forget is not carried into the next pass and re-issued; repair-negative-cleanup-retry.log shows the reverted code records only one forget call.

calls == [str(raw), str(raw)] fails if either forget or _drop_deselected_tiers bypasses _delete_source_rows, but it asserts the route rather than the delete semantics and would not catch a second, differently-worded delete pair.

sample_count() == 0 after forget([segment]) fails if samples indexed under the pre-roll path survive, which is exactly the rolled-source regression; repair-negative-rolled-source.log shows the reverted identity leaves 2 samples.
